# Research Brief: Saksoft (SAKSOFT)

**As of:** 2026-06-11 (based on latest trading session June 10, 2026)

## Overview
Saksoft Limited (NSE: SAKSOFT) is an Indian information technology services company in the Technology sector [30]. The stock closed at **₹142.28** on June 10, 2026, with a change of +1.07% [29].

## Dividends
Saksoft declared a total dividend of **₹1.00 per share** for the past 12 months consisting of:
- Interim dividend of ₹0.45 per share (November 2025) [6]
- Proposed final dividend of ₹0.55 per share (announced May 25, 2026, awaiting shareholder approval) [3]

Based on the June 9, 2026 closing price of ₹139.65 [16], the dividend yield is approximately **0.72%** [16][6][3]. (Note: yfinance reports a dividend yield of 0.70% [30] based on the same ₹1.00 DPS.)

## Valuation & Price Range
- **52-week high:** ₹253.99 [30]
- **52-week low:** ₹107.59 [30]
- **52-week change:** –29.2% [30]
- **Beta:** 0.356 [30]

## Open Questions
- **Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended March 31, 2026) financials:** Revenue, net profit, and margin figures are **not available** in this run because the financial tables in the board-meeting outcome filings [3][4] are unparsed/scanned images.
- **Full-year FY2026 revenue and net profit:** Similarly not available – the annual report [2] or investor presentation [7] may contain these sums.
- **Final dividend approval date:** The ₹0.55 final dividend is proposed [3]; the AGM date and shareholder approval status are not yet disclosed.
- **Next catalyst:** The company announced an acquisition of Augmento Labs for ₹100 cr in June 2024 [14]; no update on integration or financial impact in this run.

## Recommended Next Steps
- Manually parse the scanned tables in [3] or [4] to extract Q4 FY2026 figures.
- Consult the investor presentation [7] for a summary of full-year results.
- Check subsequent filings for AGM notice and dividend record date.
